caption: This tonkotsu broth, golden-brown and glossy, floats with noodles and green onions. In a blue and white ceramic bowl with floral patterns, dark nori, pink chashu pork, pale yellow menma, and pale pink naruto fish cake rest on a light brown wooden table.

segments_info.text: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, oval-shaped surface.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish meat, white fat, and a slightly crispy, browned edge.
The nori seaweed is dark, crinkled, and irregularly shaped with a slightly glossy, textured surface.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft texture and visible fibrous strands, curled into a gentle arc.
Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate floral pattern and raised rim, glossy finish, ornate detailing along the edge.
Naruto fish cake: pale pink swirls in translucent white, smooth surface with faint speckles, round shape.
